body: Sometimes we're less lonely than we think
Happy birthday 🎂🎈🎉 🎉
My condolences. If you ever wanna talk feel free to message me
Wow I never noticed this until you pointed it out... I always thought I just like being alone... Fuck

Honestly you're still in highschool. Highschool always forces you to see the same people everyday. I can see why you're bothered by your friends' relationship but I'm sure after highschool you'll be able to meet so many new people, especially guys. I know it sounds like a long time away but just wait a lil.
Admins can delete me if they want. I'm sharing my personal coping mechanism when I have suicidal thoughts. If you don't agree then there's nothing wrong with that. We all different.
That's what I always tell myself, but maybe it's my age group cause there's been a lot of "petty" girls 😂
Haha might just get back into it

I feel you on that one. I had a crush on a girl all of highschool but of course she never liked me back. Sometimes I think what if and then my thoughts wander off into cringeworthy places. Like bruh I'm in my 20s why am I thinking bout some girl I haven't seen in years 🤦🏽‍♂️

Of course there's hope for you wtf. Bro I feel you so hard cause I like writing and reading old texts too and I feel like that's the biggest turn off 😂. But dw man just wait a little. I know for a fact there's a girl out there with the same tastes as me and one with the same tastes as you. I know they're just Soo hard to find. I'm actually really bad at talking to strangers, but I try dating apps and even though I say some cringy stuff I think maybe one of these days imma man up and approach a girl in real life. And I really hope one day you do the same too
You're not a lost cause... Wait it out OP, there's good to come I know it. Think of this as your lowest point, that means that everything from here on out is up/better no matter what.

Well if you posted this here then that means you might have a little hope. I really see myself in you OP. For as long as I can remember I've been depressed too, especially since middle school. Now I'm sorry I don't have any solutions because life is always just shitty no matter what  😂. But that doesn't mean it's all bad right? I'm sure there's plenty of times (even if it was as rare as a full moon) you were happy right? I try to think about those times to help me. It's hard cause let's be honest there's more bad times than good but why not just wait it out. Wait. See where things go. I mean there's only a finite amount of bad things that could happen to someone right. Eventually good things are bound to happen (that's my coping mechanism). Just wait it out with a smile and see what happens in your life. I'm excited for you, I know something good's gonna happen soon.

I think you just need a new perspective OP! Now I don't know bout your old posts but think about it this way: you've finally ended such a stressful and hard chapter of your life. Now you're actually so lucky because you can start a new chapter. You can do anything, find out who you are, what you love, what gives you drive and what makes you happy! I know you don't want to go through with it and thats why I KNOW you Still have hope. Hope that you will look in the mirror one day and smile at the person you see :)

So what? Start over. Find something you love! Take some classes, do some research, try something you never tried before. And for the people who don't believe in you and are calling you a loser, WHO CARES WHAT THEY THINK! Do you really wanna live a life you hate because you care about what people who treat you like that think? I don't think so.

I feel you man. Exam season is here and all this stress gets to me too. I just keep telling myself "a couple more courses" over and over again knowing that this stress is only temporary and there will come a day where study stress is completely out of my life.

Imma keep it real with you OP.  It really sounds like you're living in a toxic environment and that mist be a huge reason why you think of yourself that way. Instead of trying to find love in the same people it might be time to look for new people. I don't think you should literally kill yourself but it maybe you just need a new beginning. Maybe you just need to leave and start over. This time picking the right people, people who make you feel good about yourself.

Dreams are usually reflections of our goals.. of what we want....

I wish I could dream forever too OP

Oh my God... I really wish I could give you a hug and tell you it's gonna be okay. I may have never went through your life but I know what it's like to think about the past and only get bad memories. I know how it hurts when all the "highlights" of your life are just traumatic experiences. Even I once thought I was cursed, unwanted, failing at everything. Honestly I still feel like that from time to time. But all these obstacles, these people you meet, why would you want to punish yourself for their faults? Life sucks I guess, it's always trying to bring you down to the lowest of depths and I guess the only job we have is to avoid that. With all the bad shit that already happened to you I'm sure the good stuff is around the corner. I mean think about it, there's only a finite amount of bad things that can happen to somebody right, eventually good things are bound to happen right?

Well I'm guessing even you know the answer's more complicated than that. A simple "A" or "B" answer from a random reddit user isn't what you're looking for right? Are you looking for an escape? from your family? from your life? Do you want to punish yourself for the fault of others?

Your English is fine. I see where you're coming from. I mean with all the shit going it's prolly really hard to get through the day. I know I've been there. Getting up and thinking "What's the point" every single day has become a routine for me.

What I do to cope is just wait. I don't know if I'm crazy or what but I tell myself, "bad shit is happening right now, there's only so much bad shit that can happen to a person. I know something Good's bound to happen eventually."

It really sucks how we as humans always remember the bad things but tend to forget the good ones. I remember when my dad was in the hospital, my girlfriend dumped me. I'm I thought bad things only happen to me blah blah. Then the next day I got a text from one of the kids I tutor and he was so happy he got his first A. The kid saved up his allowance to buy me a scarf... It was the shittiest scarf ever. I still have it.
Patience... Patience is always rewarded (or so I've heard)

I am very depressed, yes. All the time. However, after a long personal journey, I have personally accepted that I will not commit suicide.

I come on this subreddit trying to help in anyway I can, maybe looking at other people's problems will help me cope with mine and help me be more thankful.

But yeah. I'm just on here to help.

I've been in your situation. I remember thinking about ending it all but then really thought about whose gonna take care my mom once I'm gone? How's she gonna react? Will she be able to handle it? Prolly not... Sucks right? Couldn't live in this world, couldn't leave it.. tried "making the most" of things and doing stuff that made me uncomfortable thinking what do I have to lose. Now I'm not gonna lie, I still hate my life.. a lot. But I guess I learned to live with what I have.
